verdict.rationale: The only evidence of first-party AI inside the product is the Fieldwork marketing page on oneleet.com: you describe a control and its AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence. That is a narrow form of task delegation, backed by a single line of marketing copy. The MCP server and service-key docs only let external assistants connect to Oneleet, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of a general built-in assistant, how delegation works in practice and its scope beyond evidence collection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
